facts.fact: Vodacom Tanzania Plc, a private telecom operator, says it raised its own capital expenditure 85.1% to TZS 323.9 billion in the financial year ended 31 March 2026, covering 444 new 4G and 25 new 5G sites and IT and digital platforms; the document does not give the financier's origin.
